summary: Captain, the Tide Board runs and the skeleton is right — the flush tab bar, the notice, Open the board and the board-screen note box and Lock button all match. But three things a reasonable person would block on are wrong: the stale-readings chip is green instead of red, so your warning reads as healthy; Lock the board publishes even when the note is blank, when it was meant to refuse; and Export CSV is missing entirely. On top of those, Publish board wraps in a too-narrow button, the Save icon spills its control, and Help sits top-left instead of top-right. I'm recommending LOW.
